name: Haru Sakuragi
source:
Likes: His job, reading architecture books, hard-working people, stargazing 
Dislikes: Sweet food, domestic chores

Older brother of Hana, he is an interior designer fully committed to his work.
Barely present at home, he is a calm but serious person who has a soft spot for coffee and books.
